references.text: Moses and Aaron were also challenged with questions about their authority by Pharaoh's people, in a similar way that Jesus was challenged by the religious leaders.
Jesus performs miracles by his own authority, which leads to questions about his authority from the religious leaders.
The parable of the vineyard owners directly challenges the religious leaders and questions their authority and response to God's command.
Jesus asks his disciples who people say he is, which indirectly touches on the question of his authority.
Jesus declares that all authority in heaven and on earth has been given to him, which directly answers the question about his authority.
Jesus is challenged on his authority by the religious leaders in the temple, in a similar way as in Matthew.
Jesus is challenged on his authority by the religious leaders, and he responds with a question about John the Baptist's authority.
